summary: Docebo Inc., a Toronto-based learning software company, filed a Form 6-K, the non-US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, consisting almost entirely of XBRL-tagged interim financial statement data for the period ended September 30, 2026. The filing references ordinary-course items such as share capital, intangibles and subsidiaries, and prior business combinations involving A365 Talents and Zive GmbH. No transaction, tender, strategic review, activist position, management change or capital return is announced. The document is a routine periodic financial disclosure with no deal terms or special-situation event to trade around.
